import java.util.Scanner;
public class Main
{
	public static void main(String[] args)
	{
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		String str=sc.next();
		str=str+" ";
		int i, pos=0, c=0, ans=0;
		char ch, cp;
		for(i=1;i<str.length();i++)
		{
			ch=str.charAt(i);
			cp=str.charAt(pos);
			if(ch!=cp)
			{
				pos=i;
				if((c+1)%2==0)
				   ans++;
				   c=0;
			}
			else
				c++;
		}
		System.out.println(ans);
	}
}
</perturbed_code_1>
